label: Bible Study
prompt: And my spirit hath _____ in God my Saviour.
verse: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
note: Mary's song continues — she calls God her Saviour before her son is even born.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the _____, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
verse: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
note: Builders spread thin along the wall had one plan: hear the trumpet, run there — our God shall fight for us.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of _____ was found upon him, because he believed in his God.
verse: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.
note: Daniel came up from the den without a scratch, 'because he believed in his God.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Blessed is the man that endureth _____: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
verse: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
note: James's beatitude for the tested: endure it, and there's a crown of life waiting at the end.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, _____; and some, pastors and teachers;
verse: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
note: Christ's gifts to the church: apostles, prophets, 'evangelists,' pastors and teachers — for perfecting the saints.
